row_semantics_rule: each routed row safely establishes historical absence for that spp.name × holmkod pair, but absence rows may be incomplete because the published modelling workflow dropped observations with missing explanatory data

historical_source_reconstruction.island_universe: freeze exactly 471 unique holmkod values from t0-safe rows
historical_source_reconstruction.source_count_direct_gate: for the archived Historical_total_log scale, require documented log10(x+1) inversion to yield a nonnegative integer historical occupied-island count within frozen numeric tolerance; otherwise HOLD for an independently frozen supplementary Potential_islands lookup
historical_source_reconstruction.exact_species_rule: only species with archived_absent_row_count + historical_source_count == 471 have a complete historical absence set; for those species only, historical occupied sources are the complement of archived absent islands
historical_source_reconstruction.incomplete_species_rule: species with archived_absent_row_count + historical_source_count < 471 are topology-ineligible and are excluded before future outcome access
historical_source_reconstruction.impossible_species_rule: archived_absent_row_count + historical_source_count > 471 is a pre-outcome STOP
historical_source_reconstruction.validation: recompute source count, Euclidean nearest-source distance and diffuse pressure from the exact reconstructed t0 source set; archived Dist_to_historical_log is a t0-safe cross-check but is not required to recover source identity

anti_leakage: do not parse, normalize, count, summarize or persist outcome tokens during t0 projection
do not select islands or species from outcome
do not use the published AIC-simplified model as an outcome-selected reference specification
do not use future colonization success to choose graph scale, spatial blocks, rarity threshold or null topology ensemble
success_ceiling: authorize t0-only projection and reconstruction contract; future outcome remains sealed
